verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly promise web-grounded answers with built-in inline citations in a single call (Agent API and overview). The Sonar chat endpoint reference shows `citations` and `search_results` fields in the response, and the docs direct users to the Agent API for an LLM-generated answer with citations. Legacy Sonar requests are being reformulated as Agent API requests, but synchronous and streaming calls keep working. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of citation quality and single-call behavior.
